description: Use before trusting a workbook's calculations to compare recalculated formulas with Excel's saved values. Returns compared/matching totals, up to 200 mismatches with formula, saved/recalculated values and cause, feature flags, skipped counts, the workbook's dateSystem ("1900" or "1904"), and load/recalculation milliseconds. Dates are serial numbers in the workbook's date system. Above the 20000-byte response budget, mismatch details are shortened with an explicit message and totals retained. Only eligible cached formulas are compared; a matching check does not cover skipped cells or unsupported features.

path.description: Local workbook path (absolute recommended), at most 50 MiB; .xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx or .xltm.

name: check_workbook
